query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `extraServices` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `serviceNumber` varchar(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  `serviceTypeId` int NOT NULL,
  `customerId` int,
  `description` text NOT NULL,
  `costAmount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `priceAmount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `profitAmount` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `currency` enum('USD','IQD','CNY') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD',
  `exchangeRate` decimal(10,2),
  `isPaid` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `paidAt` timestamp,
  `paidAmount` decimal(10,2),
  `paymentMethod` enum('cash','card','transfer','balance'),
  `addedToBalance` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  `ledgerTransactionId` int,
  `invoiceId` int,
  `notes` text,
  `createdById` int NOT NULL,
  `createdAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
);
